definitions: A watertight enclosure pumped dry to permit construction work below the waterline, as in a riverbed or harbor.
A temporary watertight enclosure built in a body of water to allow the enclosed area to be pumped out and worked on.
examples: The construction crew built a cofferdam to repair the bridge's foundation.
Divers inspected the cofferdam for any leaks.
The cofferdam allowed workers to lay the pipeline on the riverbed.
